notes.title: Fantasy Blacksmith DLC Escape From The Forge This Friday on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Enjoy 4 new locations, teleportation, new resources, and ores for mining.
[/h1]

[b]This DLC features:[/b]

[list]
[*] portal which can be placed in the forge and can be used for teleportation to the outside world.
[*] 4 stones available in store, which transports the character to different locations.
[*] 4 new locations: Graveyard, Forest, Mines, and Cave.
[*] search and mine rare resources in the new locations.
[*] 2 new ores, which can be mined in certain locations.
[*] the book with all in-game items and the locations where you can find them.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591070/Fantasy_Blacksmith__Escape_From_The_Forge/

notes.title: Fantasy Blacksmith Changelog for Early Access Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Changelog for Early Access Update 1.3.0[/b][/u][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/51a439d28b262b4c757ef17ea09adeea20f23230.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Added:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Added Altar (located in the Mithril mines). With it, you can impose 4 additional effects on the sword (More information in the tutorial section "Esc"->Tutorial->Altar)
[*] Added a place for tempering the blade (More info "Esc"->Tutorial->Tempering)
[*] Added a few new items for the Altar that can be bought in stores or found in the mines
[*] Added 3 new soundtracks
[*] Added sound to the dice
[*] Added save and load DND nameplate mode
[*] Added 3D model for tutorial book and more tabs to it
[*] Added more item descriptions
[*] Added reset the runes on the magic table
[/list]
[u][b]Reworked/Changed:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Improved system for heating and cooling ingots by color
[*] Improved system for creating a mixture of Damascus
[*] Improved dice game
[*] Improved tutorial at the beginning of the game
[*] Improved collisions in most items
[*] Completely redone and improved tutorial menu
[*] Now you can immediately return to the current shop from the purchase menu via the "Back" button
[*] Rewrote the rules for dice
[*] Some minor changes and improvements
[/list]
[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue with loading magic effects (those that are made after this update)
[*] Fixes an issue with loading damask pattern
[*] Fixes an issue with Damascus evaluation
[*] Fixes an issue with counting points in the dice
[*] Fixes an issue with loading Slug
[*] Some minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New game - Keyboard Killer now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27432970/a2858d385f234b703383e7a06d36d667f3044e27.jpg[/img]

Keyboard Killers is not simple keyboard clicker game. In which you should kill meteors to save your starship and your friend dragon.

- 28 different levels
- 4 difficulty level
- Each level has its own cool rock song
- Create your own music on the special level with 22 various sounds

Playing for a long time you can learn to type blindly (or you can kill your keyboard)

Check on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/699240] Steam store(click)[/url]
